answer: Yes. The story uses sophisticated metaphors to illuminate intimacy, privacy, and self-understanding. Friendship as “a system of doors, most open only from one side” captures unequal access and vulnerability, while Lizzy’s unspoken love as “a room I kept furnishing for someone who never came in” makes emotional investment tangible. Recurring images of mirrors, cameras, and being seen also deepen the distinction between genuine understanding and using others for self-reflection.
